configUrl.title: Configuration URL
configUrl.description: URL to a hosted JSON configuration file. The extension will fetch this on startup and periodically refresh it.

config.title: Inline Configuration
config.description: Full or partial configuration object. Any missing fields use defaults. If both configUrl and config are set, configUrl takes precedence.

rules.description: Toggle individual blocking rules by ID. Keys are rule IDs (e.g. '1002'). Each value is an object with an 'enabled' boolean.

tabCreationWindow.description: Time window in ms for spam detection (default: 2000)

maxTabsInWindow.description: Max tabs created within the time window before triggering spam detection (default: 5)

maxHistoryPushesPerSecond.description: History pushState threshold per second before triggering flood detection (default: 50)

enableLTBEEFDetection.description: Enable LTBEEF exploit GUI detection (default: true)

enableBlobBlocking.description: Block blob URL iframes on Google Sites (default: true)

enableGameDetection.description: Detect and block game engine signatures in iframes (default: true)

enableWorkerDetection.description: Detect Cloudflare Worker proxy iframes (default: true)

enableBase64Detection.description: Detect Base64-encoded game content in scripts (default: true)

minSuspiciousFrameSize.description: Minimum iframe pixel size to be considered suspicious (default: 400)

additionalWhitelist.description: Additional domains to whitelist (added to built-in educational whitelist)

additionalBlacklist.description: Additional domains to block via dynamic rules
